mentions.name: Nesticles
mentions.description: Nesticles is a platform of lightweight, isolated, immutable desktop system containers built on modern Linux compositor technologies and specified as docker-compose projects that include all apps. Running on a Debian stable host targeting PC-grade hardware, each container consumes roughly 600MB of memory, allowing around 30 environments to run concurrently. It unifies desktop and app delivery and provides building blocks for composing useful containers, with deep theming and customization for personal or organizational use. Planned host platform support covers Debian, Ubuntu, SteamOS, Windows, and Mac, with a Steam launcher to fund development and open-source community container definitions.
mentions.audience: Individuals customizing their personal desktops, as well as organizations and companies
